mapping_json.fidelity_notes: DUAL-IDENTITY kit: (1) totem-proxy delivery (PROXY_ASCENSION, Hierophant totem archetype) + (2) the life-cost-as-weapon warp where the spell's self-damage is OUTSOURCED to the totems. Element chaos -> shadow (crosswalk s1). The payload is a HIT scaled off life+ES, not a DoT, so ailments empty (probe control centrality=none; the 'poison/wither' probe tags are minor riders, not the identity). hp_cost_scale=0.3 (engine LOCKED cap) + reservation_resource=hp captures the life-price economy, but the SIGNATURE is that the totem, not the player, pays it -- the engine has no 'redirect self-damage-cost to a proxy entity' primitive, so the life-cost lands on the chassis and the OUTSOURCING is noted/docketed. SACRIFICE_ASCENDANCY is the life-trade T4 door; PROXY_ASCENSION the totem door. Soul Mantle (totems take your ailments) + Self-Flagellation (self-curse-for-damage) is a secondary economy loop.
